transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. Welcome in—what brings you here today?

Well… thank you, Doctor. I guess I’m here because things have been going on for a few months, and I’m not sure people are really taking me seriously. I’m not trying to make a fuss or anything.

It’s just… my husband’s family, I think they’ve been quietly interfering with our money and with how people see us. Little things happen—like billing errors at work that don’t make sense, or someone at church suddenly acting different toward me—and even when people pull up records and say it doesn’t show anything, I know it connects back to them somehow. I just need someone to understand what’s really happening.
Have you ever heard voices, sounds, or seen things that other people around you don't seem to hear or see?

No, I don’t think so. I mean, I hear normal things, of course, but not voices or seeing things that aren’t there. At least… not that I’ve noticed. I’m not trying to sound difficult—I just don’t think that’s what’s been happening.

Aside from these concerns about your husband's family, how have things been going for you otherwise—are you still able to keep up with your usual work, relationships, and daily routines without much trouble?

Mostly, yes. I mean, I don’t want you to think I’m falling apart or anything. I still get up and go to work, and I do my billing clerk duties. I keep the house running, make meals, that sort of thing. I still do my gardening, and I paint when I have time.

It’s just… the trouble usually starts when I try to explain to people what my husband’s family is doing. Then people get uncomfortable or act like I’m making too much of it. But otherwise, I think I’m managing pretty well. That sounds reasonable, doesn’t it?
Do you have any medical conditions—like thyroid problems, seizures, head injuries, or use of alcohol or drugs—that started around the same time these beliefs began?

I don’t think so, no. I mean, I haven’t noticed anything like that starting around then. I’m not someone who… you know, uses drugs or anything like that. And I don’t think I have any medical problem that would explain it.

I hope that answers what you mean.
